summary: The recorded base independently reproduces the missing NCCL RMA contract. At the exact candidate commit, all 19 available regression tests pass, independent adversarial warm-up/fallback tests pass, and a clean ROCm rebuild proves that the changed allocator exports and publishes both window accessor functions. The candidate therefore fixes the reviewed Python scoping counterexample and has no reproduced source-level counterexample in this environment. However, the original issue's defining two-rank NVIDIA NCCL 2.30/NVLink put_signal/wait_signal data-transfer handshake cannot run on the assigned single AMD MI350X, so a full original-issue fix is not verified.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: collection fails because NCCL_WIN_COLL_SYMMETRIC is absent; direct probing also found no RMA table, no allocator handle collector, and no rma_communicator module.
Candidate regression suite: 19 passed and 2 hardware tests skipped because fewer than two GPUs were available.
Clean native allocator compile/link against -lrccl, dynamic load of the rebuilt .so, exported get/clear symbols, and non-None module-level ctypes bindings.
Independent synthetic non-NULL handle success, NULL-handle graceful fallback, verification-error fallback, and allocation/window cleanup; 3 passed.
The tested artifact, rather than a wheel copy, exports nccl_alloc_plug, nccl_free_plug, register, get-windows, and clear-windows entry points.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned host exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and RCCL 2.27.7. GPU presence was measured, but no candidate RMA operation executed: the required test needs at least two NVIDIA GPUs, NCCL >=2.30, and an NVLink-capable topology.

remaining_counterexamples: The real two-rank NCCL 2.30+ NVLink ring put_signal/wait_signal handshake and its independent received-data verification were not executable on this single-GPU AMD host.
The ctypes RMA bindings were checked against the NCCL 2.30.7 source declarations but were not dynamically invoked against an NVIDIA libnccl.so.2 in this environment.
remaining_limitations: Architecture mismatch: AMD MI350X/RCCL 2.27.7 cannot qualify NVIDIA NCCL 2.30 one-sided RMA semantics.
Only one GPU is assigned, while both candidate hardware tests require two ranks and two GPUs.
Passing mocks and a successful allocator rebuild establish loader/control-flow correctness, not NCCL proxy data movement or NVLink ordering semantics.
